caseStudy.context: A Fixed Income Securities project: construct a ₹1,000 crore, long-duration Indian bond portfolio for a development finance institution (DFI) mandate.
caseStudy.role: Project Lead. Led construction of the portfolio and built its yield, duration and convexity model.
approach: Selected 10 Indian bonds: an 85% sovereign/AAA core with a 15% municipal satellite.
Modelled portfolio yield to maturity, modified duration and convexity.
Stress-tested 12 rate and credit scenarios, including the live RBI rate hike.
Checked the portfolio against the 20 mandate constraints.
